action.objective: Verify Qh6 as the reserved candidate after Black's Rg7 forced the queen back.
action.rationale: Broad search at completed depth 3 shows Qh6 best (exact -67) vs Qh4 upper -71 and Nf6/Ng5 much worse. Qh7+ won the h7 pawn but Rg7 forces the queen to retreat; Qh6 keeps pressure on the restricted Black king. Verify this single candidate at full depth for safety and a concrete line.
